items.title: The Similars
items.reason: Eight strangers are trapped in a remote bus station during a worldwide abnormal storm and progressively confront a phenomenon that changes their faces into the same person. Radio reports broaden the anomaly beyond the station; seizures and transformations shift suspicion among infection, government action and impossible causes; locked exits intensify the contained-world puzzle; altered photographs and objects show that reality itself is changing; and the sick child Ignacio, his comic-book scenario and eventual reality-altering control progressively reframe the event toward an impossible alien-linked cause. The mystery is worked across most of the compact runtime with several extra twists and sustained paranoia, while the deliberately 1960s-styled presentation and horror emphasis reduce the baseline fit without triggering a guardrail.
